hero.heading: Sushi Making Course in Dhaka
hero.subheading: Learn the precise art of Japanese sushi from 5-star master chefs. 100% hands-on practical training in rolling and presentation.

overview.title: The Precision of Sushi Craft
overview.text:
Sushi is a global culinary sensation, and professional sushi rollers are highly sought after by luxury hotels and premium restaurants in Bangladesh and abroad. This specialty short course focuses entirely on the traditional techniques of Washoku, specifically the art of sushi.

From washing, cooking, and vinegar-seasoning the perfect sushi rice (Shari) to masterfully slicing raw salmon and tuna, you will learn the exact steps required to create restaurant-grade sushi.

highlights.title: Sushi Rice Science
highlights.description: Mastering vinegar seasoning, cooling, and rice texture.

highlights.title: 4 Roll Styles
highlights.description: Maki, Nigiri, Temaki, and Uramaki rolling techniques.

highlights.title: Sashimi Slicing
highlights.description: Learn professional knife skills for slicing fresh fish.

highlights.title: Premium Ingredients
highlights.description: Work with grade-A Nori, Salmon, Wasabi, and Gari.

features: Hands-on rice preparation and cooking temperature control
Traditional bamboo mat rolling and cutting techniques
Plating aesthetics and dynamic presentation formats
Handling fresh raw seafood and sanitation safety
Ingredient sourcing guides for local and imported materials
Accredited specialty certificate awarded upon completion

table.heading: Course Details & Intake Info
rows: CIB Specialty Certificate in Japanese Gastronomy
Age 16+ with basic kitchen interest. No prior chef experience required.

faqs.question: Do I need to buy ingredients like salmon myself?
faqs.answer: No. CIB provides all raw materials including fresh salmon, nori sheets, crab sticks, and specialty sushi rice for all practical sessions.

faqs.question: Will this course help me start a business?
faqs.answer: Yes. Sushi businesses have high-profit margins in Dhaka. We cover portion costing and commercial presentation styles designed for restaurant owners.

cta.subheading: Upgrade your culinary skills and stand out as a certified specialty chef.
